formulations.Notes: Tg (-66 °C) was extrapolated from the Tg-composition plot (Fig. 3), not measured directly. Conductivity was measured on supercooled amorphous melts (from Table 4). formulations.Notes: EO/Li = 128/1 (Li:EO = 0.0078), c = 0.169 mol/kg of electrolyte. Tg of -64 °C was extrapolated from the Tg-composition plot (Fig. 3), not measured. As-cast mixtures with EO/Li > 12 are an amorphous phase (invariant Tg -40 ± 2 °C) in equilibrium with crystalline PEO. Conductivity was measured on supercooled amorphous melts. LiTFSI was dried 24 h at 150 °C and 1 h at 170 °C under high vacuum. Mixtures were prepared from 1-5% methanol solutions.

formulations.Notes: EO/Li = 11/1 (Li:EO ≈ 0.091), c = 1.296 mol/kg. Composition lies in the crystallinity gap (6 < EO/Li < 12) of the PEO-LiTFSI system, so the electrolyte is amorphous. Tg is from DSC of melt-quenched supercooled mixtures. At the same composition, the reduced conductivity (T - Tg = 110 °C) of LiTFSI is about 10 times that of LiMPSA. Conductivity was measured by impedance spectroscopy with stainless steel electrodes in a bulk cell.

formulations.Notes: EO/Li = 2/1, c = 2.67 mol/kg of electrolyte; Tg from Table 4 (measured, not extrapolated). The PEO-LiTFSI system forms a 2/1 crystalline compound (C2) in its phase diagram; conductivity measured on amorphous/molten electrolyte. Above ~1.8 mol/kg LiTFSI shows an abrupt sigmoidal decrease in reduced molar conductivity attributed to a percolation threshold (depletion of free EO units); for EO/salt < 3 the electrolyte is fully complexed PEO dissolved in molten LiTFSI (extrapolated Tg of LiTFSI = 50 °C).
formulations.Reference: Lascaud, S.; Perrier, M.; Vallée, A.; Besner, S.; Prud'homme, J.; Armand, M. Phase Diagrams and Conductivity Behavior of Poly(ethylene oxide)-Molten Salt Rubbery Electrolytes. Macromolecules 1994, 27, 7469-7477.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Low-MW PEO (Aldrich), Mn = 3.9–4.5 kDa, Mw/Mn = 1.02–1.21, purified by precipitation in petroleum ether from THF solution. Salt: LiCF3SO2N(CH2)3OCH3 (LiMPSA), EO/Li = 10 (Li:EO = 0.1), c = 1.498 mol/kg. PEO–LiMPSA is a simple binary eutectic system; as-cast mixtures contain crystalline PEO or salt, and no Tg was seen for as-cast mixtures. Tg (-53 °C) was measured on the melt-quenched, supercooled mixture. EO/Li = 10 was the highest LiMPSA concentration measured; higher contents gave saturated mixtures above 60 °C.
formulations.Notes: Conductivity comes from Table 3 and was measured on amorphous (melted/supercooled) electrolyte between stainless-steel electrodes by impedance (5 Hz–13 MHz). Tg rises by 1.3 °C/mol% for LiMPSA below saturation. At EO/Li = 11, reduced conductivity (at T - Tg = 110 °C) is about 10 times lower than for LiTFSI. The authors attribute this to polarization of the MPSA anion.
formulations.Reference: Lascaud, S.; Perrier, M.; Vallée, A.; Besner, S.; Prud'homme, J.; Armand, M. Phase Diagrams and Conductivity Behavior of Poly(ethylene oxide)-Molten Salt Rubbery Electrolytes. Macromolecules 1994, 27, 7469–7477.

formulations.Polymer system Notes: PEO (Mn 3.9-4.5 kDa, Mw/Mn 1.02-1.21) + potassium salt KCF3SO2N(CH2)3OCH3 (KMPSA), EO/K = 1/1, c = 3.30 mol/kg of electrolyte. Mixture lies in the concentrated regime above the composition of fully complexed PEO (EO/salt = 3), described as fully complexed PEO dissolved in molten KMPSA; amorphous, homogeneous at room temperature.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Best VTF fit for EO/K = 1 electrolyte gave T0 = (Tg - 44) °C, i.e. about -60 °C; fit over 45-105 °C. Authors note T0 rises with increasing temperature range (departure from VTF). A and B values not reported.
formulations.Notes: Cation is K+ (not Li). Conductivity from Table 1 (duplicate cells, reproducibility better than 5%). Figure 9 VTF plots use T0 = Tg - 25 °C. Small minimum in sigma_R/c near c = 3.3 mol/kg (EO/K = 1) suggests the fully complexed polymer slightly hinders ion mobility. PEO PDI 1.02-1.21.
formulations.Reference: Lascaud, S.; Perrier, M.; Vallée, A.; Besner, S.; Prud'homme, J.; Armand, M. Macromolecules 1994, 27, 7469-7477

formulations.Polymer system Notes: Low-molecular-weight PEO (Aldrich), Mn = 3.9-4.5 kDa, Mw/Mn = 1.02-1.21, purified by precipitation. Mixed with KTFSI, K(CF3SO2)2N, at EO/K = 8 (c = 1.489 mol/kg of electrolyte). The conductivity samples were amorphous, supercooled mixtures. KTFSI forms 10/1 and 1.5/1 crystalline compounds with PEO. The upper limit of 1.5 mol/kg for KTFSI was set by the liquidus of the 1.5/1 compound.
formulations.VFT Notes (above temp): Global best VTF fit (sigma = A exp[-B/(T-T0)]) over 30-100 °C gives T0 = -61 °C. Separate fits over 30-80 °C and 50-100 °C give T0 = -68 and -52 °C, respectively, so T0 rises with temperature, a departure from VTF behavior. A and B were not reported.
formulations.Notes: Potassium salt (KTFSI), not a lithium salt. EO/K = 8, 1.489 mol/kg. Tg is for the melt-quenched, supercooled mixture. A VTF fit with fixed T0 = Tg - 25 °C (= -61 °C) gave excellent fits (Fig. 8). The conductivity maximum for PEO-KTFSI is near 0.8-1.0 mol/kg.
